title: VGG-16/19
paper_title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
core_mech: 以高度同质的 3×3 plain-convolution blocks 规律加深到 16/19 层，无残差连接。
core_mech_en: Homogeneous stacking of 3×3 plain convolutional blocks systematically deepened to 16–19 layers without residual shortcuts.
input_desc: 固定尺寸 RGB/医学 2D 图像
input_en: Fixed-size RGB or 2D grayscale medical image
output_desc: 分类 logits 或供下游使用的多层卷积特征
output_en: Classification logits or multi-stage intermediate convolutional feature maps

source.title: VGG-16/19
notes: Maintained VGG-16 and VGG-19 implementation. Author archive and pretrained weights must not be confused with a complete original training reproduction.

adapter.name: VGG-16/19
adapter.mechanism: Upstream make_layers with the VGG-16 D configuration, reduced channels and three-layer classifier.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Default runs VGG-16; set variant=19 for VGG-19. Adaptive pooling 1x1 and narrow classifier replace the original head.
